content.content:
86:Common: piers y 1 at corners and every 3 along each wall and under porch posts; skirting between piers y 1 (lattice = open trapdoors of the house's trim wood, or the fence named); deck y 2; walls from y 3. Windows 1 wide x 2 high (y 4..5 ground, y 9..10 upper) unless stated, glass_pane in the wall plane, a top-slab sill one cell outside (not where a porch deck already is). Corner boards flush, head plate at y 6 (and y 11 on two storeys).
88:**Plot 0 double shotgun (x 1..10):** piers `bricks`, skirting `birch_trapdoor` lattice. Walls `light_blue_terracotta` (dusty-blue clapboard) y 3..6 and the front gable triangle; corner boards + head plate `stripped_birch_log` (white); a white frieze board `birch_slab` (top) under the front eave. Front (z 9), symmetrical about the party wall: doors x 4 and x 7 (both `bamboo_door`, tall: door y 3..4 + glass_pane transom y 5), windows x 2 and x 9 (1x3 floor-length, y 3..5, the New Orleans "shotgun" window) with `dark_oak_trapdoor` shutters full height on the OUTER side of each window only, at x 1 and x 10 (z 8, y 3..5). Party wall x 5..6 shows on the front as a 2-wide white pilaster `stripped_birch_log` y 3..6. Gable: 2-wide louvred vent `birch_trapdoor` (open) x 5..6 y 9, a sunburst of birch_slab rays round it. Porch: deck `dark_oak_planks` y 2; posts `stripped_birch_log` y 3..6 at x 1, 4, 7, 10 (z 7) — the steps x 5..6 between the two middle posts; beam `stripped_birch_log` axis x y 6; gingerbread brackets `birch_stairs` upside-down under the beam each side of each post; rail `birch_fence` y 3 except x 5..6. Sides x 1 / x 10: windows at z 11 and z 15 (z 12 and z 14 stay solid for the bed heads). Back (z 16): back doors x 2 and x 9, the twin stack between them.
90:**Plot 1 Creole cottage (x 15..22):** piers `bricks` with a continuous brick front plinth y 1 under the galerie. Walls `cherry_planks` (pink painted board) y 3..6; corner boards and head plate `stripped_dark_oak_log`. Front (z 10, under the galerie): TWO pairs of French doors, x 16..17 and x 20..21 (`dark_oak_door` pairs, hinges outward, y 3..4) each with a glass_pane transom y 5 and board-and-batten shutters `warped_trapdoor` (green) folded flat beside each pair at x 15/x 18 and x 19/x 22 (z 9, y 3..5); x 18..19 between the pairs plain wall. Galerie z 7..9: deck `dark_oak_planks` y 2, slim posts `dark_oak_fence` y 3..5 at x 15, 19, 22 (z 7) topped by a `stripped_dark_oak_log` beam axis x y 6 (the roof's front eave rests on it); low rail `dark_oak_fence` y 3 between posts except x 17..18 (steps). Ceiling of the galerie = the roof's underside (open, rafters show). Gable ends x 15 / x 22: cherry boards to the ridge, a 1x1 attic window at z 12 y 9 (east only; west is the stack). West wall windows z 11 and z 16 (clear of the stack z 12..14); east wall windows z 12 and z 15. Back (z 17): windows x 17 and x 20 y 4..5, no back door. The brick stack stands proud on the west gable, `bricks` with a `deepslate_bricks` band, running up beside the verge to y 14.
96:**Plot 4 gable-front-and-wing (x 49..58):** piers `cobblestone` (1 in 10 mossy), skirting `oak_fence`. Walls `cyan_terracotta` (blue-grey painted clapboard); corner boards + head plates `stripped_birch_log`; gable block walls y 3..8 (knee course y 8), wing walls y 3..6. Front gable face (z 9, x 53..58): two tall windows x 54 and x 57 (y 4..5), attic pair x 55..56 y 9..10, a `birch_trapdoor` vent x 55..56 y 11; verge boards birch. waste.what: Verified the attic room with no real walls: the local build has no plot 4 shell, floor or stair, so the walk and bed-head checks report false failures and I had to read the floor grid by eye.
